files.role: numeric and condition whitelist from experiment artifacts
literature/numeric/factual claim checks; not an executed-code method-provenance binder in the inspected surface

observations.text: SAGE's public VerifiedRegistry builds a whitelist of measured numeric values and condition names from experiment artifacts, while paper_verifier deterministically rejects unverified numbers in strict results/experiment contexts.

The paper explicitly scopes the reporting gate to numbers and table conditions and documents method-provenance mismatches: generated prose can name datasets, libraries, models, or statistical tests not used by executed code.

The paper reports metrics-bearing outputs of 11/12 (92%) versus 5/12 (42%) for the reflection baseline and still identifies faithful implementation/method-provenance grounding as an open bottleneck. Numeric grounding therefore cannot be treated as complete scientific-claim grounding.

inference.name: METHOD_CLAIM_PROVENANCE_COVERAGE
inference.text: Completion/evidence coverage must include methodological claims against executed code/config/dataset artifacts, not only numeric values. Numeric-table verification cannot authorize prose-level method claims.

protocol_relation: Existing verifier-observability v3 already represents requirement-by-artifact membership and falsifier digest binding, so this evidence strengthens that invariant without justifying a duplicate validator mutation.
next_probe: Inspect whether any autonomous-science system deterministically binds method prose claims to executed code/config artifacts, ideally with a matched ablation or adversarial evaluation.
